teaser: AgentiCCells' first offering: a £500 website as an atomic cell, steered by the customer from their browser with a key, handed over to their GitHub.
core_idea: AgentiCCells' first offering is a public website as an atomic cell for a one-off price anchored at £500: an order on a queue, an agentic team that builds, a preview on agenticcells.app or .site, the customer steering it with a browser key and signed requests on a vault lane read hourly, and a handover to their GitHub with three months to bring their own domain. A second mode sets the team up in the customer's own GitHub and Claude accounts. It scales by capacity, with Angelo Leggio, Silvio Switha and José Bota as implementers and Vicky Wang as project manager.
